data.body: PANEL VERDICT (2026-06-04): accuracy=ACCURATE (gap+root-cause confirmed), fitness=delivers single-override, security=SOUND-WITH-CONDITIONS. Fix = 3ebb DD4 unit 5 (wire ael_sha_is_exempt into verify-session-provenance, additive/fail-closed, before the covering-PR lookup). SHOWSTOPPER the panel surfaced: the opus-gate is procedural-only — fp-recovery-record-exemption.sh trusts --reviewer-hash without verifying it against a real reviewer-findings.json, and the closure-key is agent-reachable, so honoring the ledger in PROVENANCE (which decides whether the LLM runs) could let an agent self-launder un-reviewed code (the v4 trailer hole, signed). MUST code-enforce the opus-gate (C1) + scope to exempt_by=fp-recovery (C2) + establish the key boundary (C3) BEFORE wiring provenance or provisioning the key to CI. Full conditions on 3ebb (DD4 unit 5) + 3ee4 (P8c).
